flag: PEACEAI_TEST_EXISTING (dev path); Job A only via the hash-pinned approved list
scope: one NEW test file next to an existing plain, unprotected, non-test module, importing only the named exported function; checks in the ADD_TEST_CASE bullet grammar (is / equals / throws; no rejects, no Fix line), every check calling the target with literal arguments; no source edit; target fully typed with string/number/boolean (arrays), 0-4 parameters, provably pure by a transitive module-local analysis; own trigger 'add a characterization test for'
grading: fix-free: pass on today's code three times (confined), then fail by assertion failures only with the target's body replaced by the write-only type-default stub (M23 route, reads narrowed to the test, the module's relative import closure, package.json lookups and node_modules); passes-with-stub is REJECTED_PASSES_BOTH; anything else UNGRADABLE
